spans.s: हट् r. 1st cl. (हटति) To shine, to be bright.

हट्ट m. (-ट्टः) A market, a movable market, a fair.
 f. (-ट्टी) A petty
market or fair.
 E. हट् to shine, ट aff., form irr.

हट्टचौरक m. (-कः) A thief, one stealing at fairs and markets.
 E. हट्ट a
market, and चौर a theif, कन् pleonasm.

हट्टविलासिनी f. (-नी)
 1. A sort of perfume.
 2. A whore.
 3. Turmeric.
 E. हट्ट
a market, विलस् to wanton or delight, णिनि and ङीप् affs.

हाटक mfn. (-कः-का or -की-कं) Golden, of gold, (as a weight or coin.)
 n.
(-कं) Gold.
 E. हट् to shine, ण्वुल् aff.
हाटकगिरि m. (-रिः) An epithet of mount MERU.

हाटकमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Made of gold, golden.
 E. हाटक gold, मयट् aff.
